text:
Update: a few years later and still going strong. This little "chiller" outperforms any I've had in the past. It keeps drinks very cold despite the fact that it has a glass door. It's installed in a bar, and for nicely. Make sure you have a little bit of room for ventilation. I like the soft glow the light provides, but you can turn that off if it's not for you. The racks are somewhat adjustable so I've had everything from a pony keg too a cooler full of 12 oz cans. I would happily recommend this cooler to anyone and it couldn't be best at the price I paid.

Original:
So far, I love this cooler. It was chilling so cold, i had ice forming at only 6, so I turned it down to 4, and no more problem. Its getting installed in a bar in a week so we will see performance then.

I purchased in January with a three year warranty that has mysteriously disappeared on Amazon it quit working on November 21st just before Thanksgiving.  Less then a year and still trying to find out what protection I had. It will no longer go under 50 degrees. To boot the 3 year protection site wont recognize order number for either the plan or the stupid fridge. No way to get ahold of anybody , I'm steaming pissed.
Works great. Arrived timely and as described.
Love it!!! It keeps drinks ice cold and very quiet. I use it in my salon.
This looks so beautiful in my kitchen but it stopped cooling after 3 days of use. It's positioned properly with ventilation on all sides, it gets very hot.

Opps. Door is NOT actually reversible. We had to return as it would not work for us as a left hand opening device. The instructions claimed the door is reversible which is not actually the case with this item.
door will not stay on hinge, frame damage on top and bottom hinge is bent- ordering a replacement
Great fridge. Looks good. My drinks are now cold.
PERFECTION! Works so well and is beautiful and everyone keeps asking me where I got it! Holds SO MANY drinks and the light that shines looks super classy.

Opened the product and it appeared in good shape. I Plugged in the next day and it was Louder than expected.  Read instructions and it said noises are normal...and I figured I would just deal with it since it is in the basement.  A week later,  the noise is gone and so is the cold air!!! It no longer keeps my beverages cold.  The fan still runs...but the compressor stopped.  I would like to send it back...but the box is gone.  Seller please advise on return and I can update my review.  Send a new and I can send this back with the new box?

The refrigerator came damaged (the shipping box was not). The door hinge was bent, the bottom bracket was bowed outward and the fridge makes a loud rattling noise while running. We have requested a replacement. I will update this review when we get the replacement, but I'm very disappointed with the first round and the inconvenience of having to go through the return and replace process.

The first refrigerator that I ordered was defective and Amazon quickly helped me reorder a new one and paid for the return. YAY Amazon! The replacement works perfectly. I have a thermometer that I keep in it and I set the unit at 7. The temp is holding steady at 38 degrees. It only took a few hours for the unit to come up to temp.  Have had no problems with freezing beverages.  I do get some moisture on the outside of the glass due to humidity but when the house A/C is on it stays clear. I am very happy with this unit.
The lock is perfect if you have kids around.  We put our best beer collection in it.
Got to me quick and is a very good price.
Only gets to 45-50 degrees when it's 80 outside
Looks great and chills very well. Good buy!
Fridge is stuck at 45 degrees, cant get any colder. not happy considering advertised as high 30s.

Works great now! Very satisfied after 5 months.

Initial install was under counter-top but, open on each side about 4in. There was not enough air movement/ventilation and the auto shut-off was tripping because of the high heat build-up.

Be sure to heed the note to allow for adequate air circulation around and on top. Not successful for under counter install.

So far it works well. I was ready to ship it back after first glance at the condition of the shipping box. I doubt it could handle one more transfer. Product was damaged , bent hinges, door fell off and rear corner bent from a hard drop. Found 5 door bearings under unit. I work on refrigeration equipment so repairs were nothing new to me. Exterior 3 sides warmed quickly and could hear refrigerant entering evap. plate so charge was still there. I chose this unit because of the forced air evap, fan motor. Box cools faster and more evenly compared to a static unit. The LED light is now our night light for the kitchen area. The front has plastic feet but compressor area in the rear is metal base sitting on the floor. DO NOT SLIDE unit on flooring or it will damage tile and wood finishes. Maybe something fell out of the box since the bottom was open. Over all I'm still going with 5 stars since shipping damage is not the fault of the equipment manufacturer. .03c

I got this fridge because my main concern is truly cold beer. Based on other feedback on other fridges, I read that the beer does not get as cold as most people expect.  In reading other reviews on this specific fridge, a major pro was getting cold beer.  I only expect to use this for canned beer and so far, it is just perfect.  I use the basket on the bottom for the larger cans.  The door opens and closes perfectly.  The light is great, and the temperature control is easy to use.  Other reviews point out the noise on this fridge, saying it is too loud compared to others.  I can agree that if you truly listen for it, you do notice the hum. It is louder than my last mini man cave fridge, but it is not an annoying clanging, just a louder hum, when you tell yourself to listen for it.  To me, I consider it white noise.  Especially if the TV is going, then you do not notice it at all.
Really great quality for a good value.  I'm on my second one and the water has tasted great.  So easy to reorder from here as soon as the filter light comes on.
I just installed one of these and all seems to be working well. Water has better pressure and tastes great. Can't beat the value.
great fit, water comes out with good force, tastes great. no leaks. at the price, I can afford to change the filter.
We have very clean sediment free water but the light goes on and says change the filter so I do.  Can't tell any difference.
This was terrible in my Samsung.  It didn't fit properly.  Water leaked all over and out of my fridge.  I spent hours cleaning up. I give it zero stars.
Fits great, works beautifully, great price.  Nuff said.
They Leak.

The filter came exactly as pictured and very quickly, but unfortunately it didn't fit our refrigerator tight enough or something because it was causing water to leak into our deli drawers.  I returned it for a full refund and customer service was very helpful.  I purchased a Samsung branded filter at a local big box store and the leaks stopped, so I am confident this filter was our issue.

Works great in my Samsung French Door style refrigerator.  This is my second one.  The first lasted about 6 months and neither one leaked at all.  Best of all, it was almost 1/3 third the cost of the Samsung version!
Hard to rate a water filter.  I installed it and it works!
Works great ! It was the same one that came with the refrigerator!
This filter was easy to install an worked well in Samsung RF32FMQBSR/AA. This replacement filter by Refresh was half the price of a Samsung filter.
Great deal and works well!

Great price and fits my Samsung refrigerator. Only reason for not rating 5 stars is that I can't tell if the filter is locked in position. It doesn't leak, but it doesn't seem to be locked, either. Not sure if this is an issue with my fridge or the filter.
I've order twice now and no problems either time. Would definitely order again.
Thanks
The water has a funny taste.
These only last 2 weeks and then you have to put a new one in.

Price was good. Item arrived as expected. Packaging was easy to open.
Filter did not leak. Another successful transaction and happy customer.
A little hard to push in but once it's in and turned it works great.  The top hole is different so make sure it's right. Circle  not square
Arrived fast, installed easily and pure water!

Let me start out first by saying that I was compensated for my review of this water filter. It was very professionally packaged in a ready to sell retail box. It was nearly identical to the Samsung filter, and popped into the refrigerator  very easily. I ran the recommended 3 gallons of water through it to clear the lines and flush the filter, and so far so good. There is no noticeable difference in water pressure or in water taste. There are no leaks or anything and this appears to be a well made unit & I would definitely purchase from this seller again!
Great value.
Easy install.  Works well!!
So much easier than searching local stores for the correct style! Good pricing.
It's advertised to last 6 months and it lasts as promised

100% compatible with my Samsung Refrigerator; fits easily; but on specs it does not mention if it filtrates "lead". Water taste? Better than without the filter but not as better as other filters I tried.
Works great
Exactly as described

These filters are a great value. They perform as good as branded filters for much less cost.
They don't leak and do not seem to cause problems with the water system in my refrigerator.
I will buy again.

I was looking for a frugal option to the very expensive Samsung OE filters and stumbled across these. I went for the 4 pack, thinking it would save me money and time over the long run. Boy, was I wrong. Seller shipped quickly, there were no problems there. The first filter installed and worked fine. I could tell these filters were perhaps not as effective as the OE filters - the flow rate was very high, suggesting to me that the water was moving through the carbon awfully quick (therefore maybe not as much carbon?). The first filter lasted a very long time, which struck me as odd, as I thought it should bugger up after awhile. Anyway, the real trouble started after I replaced the first filter. The morning after I changed the filter, I can to my kitchen to find my refrigerator and floor flooded. The filter was not seating properly. Removing and reinstalling the filter did not correct the problem. So I tossed the second filter and went for a third. Same issue - it leaked all over the fridge and floor. There were no visible defects or issues, but the filter was not seating and locking properly.

At this point, I said screw it and paid the full price for a Samsung OE filter. Worked perfectly and without issue.

I cannot recommend this in good faith to anyone. I don't believe the carbon filter itself is anywhere near as effective as the Samsung filters and there were clearly manufacturing/quality issues that proved to be a big headache for me. I
The filter light did not go off on the refrigerator. I don't even know if the filter is working.
Really good

This is my second purchase.  I like this product - I would buy again - ONLY COMPLAINT is Samsung Model I have makes it LOOK like the filter is engaged fully when actually it is only located in BUT NOT PUSHED FIRMLY against the water tap inside.  Result.  Leakage - about 10-minutes later and lots of mopping.  Vendor:  Please include a small slip of paper stating to PUSH filter IN very firmly first - then twist.  This would have saved me a lot of mopping.
Works as good as the OEM and is a lot less expensive...I just re-ordered..
Met all expectations
works goood i like it
Delivered quickly - works great!
Great substitute for the more expensive ones
Great product at super price. I used this filter and it works perfectly, now have replaced it with the same product, and bought a spare for the next replacement to save time.
Water filter was exactly like the old one and installed easily.
Good filters, great price.
Fits fine in my Samsung fridge, no leaks, stronger stream coming out now and water tastes fine. I will buy again when the time comes.
Worked well with my Samsung and can't beat the price.
Great product at very good price. Worked as expected and fast delivery.
As advertised. Delivered on time again as promised.
This was a great deal.. worked perfectly and for half the price that i have been paying.. thank you Buck

This water filter looked like it was going to work but we soon found out differently. We had this plugged in right before we went to bed. When we woke up and went to get a glass of water (nearly 8 hours later) we were greeted with a puddle directly in front of the refrigerator. After further inspection I found that it was leaking from around the filter area.
I had bought this product before with no problems,therefore, I do not know whether the design has changed or not. Whatever the case, I now have to replace a fair portion of my wood laminate floorng due to the puddle having sunk between the cracks and warped the flooring. Do yourself a favor and avoid the short term savings unless you are already in the market for a new floor.
I went back and looked at the filter and compared it to the old one and the opening is quite a lot larger than it was on the old one and is misrepresented in the items photos which were provided by the seller.
Installed easily and worked well and got it quickly with the Prime.
This water filter DID NOT WORK. It worked fine for a moment then all of a sudden water was leaking everywhere. WILL NOT BUY AGAIN.
Execellent water flow, removes chlorine taste well.
This product is great, my water tastes good again!
Works fine, price is the winner. Others charge $50. for one filter...ridiculous!
Works as intended.
On time, as promised, good packaging.  Will buy again.
Arrived promptly, no damage and worked as advertised. Will buy again.

I have the ability to measure particulate count in water. Water from my faucet measures 134 ppm. After flushing the system in my refrigerator, water through this filter measures 124 ppm. So this filter has removed 10 ppm of particulate. Which is some. Just to give you a point of reference water from the gallon containers at Wal Mart is measuring 4 ppm and Aquafina bottled water is measuring 1 ppm. The brand name Samsung filters were around 100 ppm as I remember. So even those can't touch the bottled waters on particulate counts.

Will retest this water at a later point to see if it improves.
Popped out the old (Samsung) one, popped in this one, ran a few pitchers of water through it... no issues. Easy peasy.
Fantastic value...works great...will not hesitate to purchase again!!  Love working with this company!
Works just like the original filter. Will definitely buy again.
Works as designed, way cheaper then the O.E. Samsung filter.
Very good fit and quality. Will buy again.
Fantastic replacement filter at a MUCH lower cost!  Just make sure you follow the instructions to run water through it before you drink any.  It took about 2 gallons to run clear.
No issues with this filter and it was much less expensive than the Samsung.  I will buy again.
Perfect

water tasted bad until a few liters went through. But that's what the directions tell us isn't it? 4 stars because the Samsung warning light won't go off. The last replacement was a Samsung and the idiot light stopped right after I installed the new filter.

The water and ice coming from our refrigerator tasted like chlorine. It was absolutely awful and we pumped about 25 gallons of water through it to try and alleviate the taste without ANY luck - it never let up. Unfortunately this came in a pack of two and now both of them are in the garbage.
people are blaming the filter size. Its the rubber O-Ring that is causing leakage. Could be a simple fix.

I ordered these filters as replacements for my Samsung refrigerator.  I followed package directions for installation.  The filters were either not the correct size, or they did not seal.  I experienced water all over the bottom of the refrigerator section, under where the filter is installed.  I checked several times to make sure this is where the water was leaking from, and verified that the filter did not fit correctly.  Would not recommend these filters.
We have a Samsung refrigerator, and this filter does not work. It leaks all over the place. If you have a Samsung refrigerator do not buy this filter.
They leak
This is not a Samsung filter like the picture showed, Do not buy this filter i wished i had read the reviews before buying. they also will not accept returns.
Good
Very good quality. Very absorbent
Work just as well as store bought - much less expensive!
Perfect! So easy to use!
Leaks horribly. Will not buy again.
Did the job efficiently
Fits perfect, did not have to leave house
great
Within a few days of installing it, it leaked water all over bottom of refrigerator. It was not equivalent to the name brand as stated. Was a wasted purchase
It's good.
It's awesome! Really easy to clean and long enough to fit over even really big sinks! You can use it as a dish dryer or lay washed veggies on it!
Works well over sink and on counter as a dish drying rack
This works so well for our tiny kitchen, it's exactly what we needed.
I really like this it was easy to use and store away . Plus no more towels for drying just put your dishes on top of the sink silicone and go.
Best thing ever to save space when lots of dishes / pans to clean

Everything about this product is positive!  It holds up to our largest/heaviest pans!  We do a lot of hand washing and did not want to take up counter space for them to air dry, so this over the sink option works out well for us.  You can roll it up off to the side of the sink when not in use.  We have had no issues with the product!
I like it. serves my purpose. I like that it rolls and unrolls... easy to put away.
I love this!  It is super sturdy and it fits perfectly on my sink.  It's coating is easy to clean off and rolls up tight when not in use.  I happy so happy I got tjis
A great tool for those with limited space and no dishwasher

This product truly earns it five stars as an attractive, easily adjustable drying rack for over the sink. It's ideal for setting down just rinsed cups, glasses, and utensils. It saves time by letting these items dry without taking up much space. It frees me to cook for my family. I am so glad that I purchased this item. Amazon makes it easy with free ship for Prime Members.
very useful product. Sturdy build, holds heavy utensils without buckling. Very satisfied.
Great width for my sink but length is a little too long but still works real well

I just ordered my second drying rack.  No, nothing went wrong with the first one.  I love it so much, I purchased another.  I have a very large sink.  I use it for drying dishes, cooling cookies and bread, rinsing fruit (plums in photo)...you name it, this rack is in constant use.  I originally purchased it so I could conveniently roll it up and put it behind the faucet when I wasn't using it.  That is basically 10% of the time.  The rest of the time it is in use.  It looks great, washes in the dishwasher if you like, and is extremely sturdy.  By the way, no one paid me for this 5-star review.  It is simply the truth.

I just ordered my second drying rack.  No, nothing went wrong with the first one.  I love it so much, I purchased another.  I have a very large sink.  I use it for drying dishes, cooling cookies and bread, rinsing fruit (plums in photo)...you name it, this rack is in constant use.  I originally purchased it so I could conveniently roll it up and put it behind the faucet when I wasn't using it.  That is basically 10% of the time.  The rest of the time it is in use.  It looks great, washes in the dishwasher if you like, and is extremely sturdy.  By the way, no one paid me for this 5-star review.  It is simply the truth.
I love this dish rack. It's a great space saver and I love the fact that you can roll it up and set it aside when not being used. It looks so much nicer than a traditional dish drying rack.
Great item works great in a small kitchen great purchase
Very sturdy wife loves it which makes me love it.
Its great & ideal for drying small items
Works greats! Highly recommend.The fact when you're done you can neatly roll it up and put it away and not take up space is awesome for an un-clutter kitchen area.
Awesome seller, Fast shipping, Great pricing!  Can't seem to stop buying these for family, friends etc.... They make great gifts, everyone seems to love them!
For those of you who has a large kitchen sink, this is really a godsend.  I think the key to buying something like this is to measure it before buying it.  Mine fits my sink perfectly.

Coolest dish rack ever!  You should totally buy one.  You won't be disappointed.  The rolling feature is so nice.  You can just roll back a few inches to utilize the sink below.  Stays in place and easy to wipe up.

This is a really convenient and sturdy rack.  Fits great over my double sink and folds up and out of the way so easy.  I like the color and the price was more reasonable than other similiar racks.  Great buy overall.

This is genius.  It is larger and heavier than I thought, which is a good thing because it fully spans the sink (as in the picture) and is VERY sturdy.  In Europe, you can buy a cabinet for above your sink that has fixed drying racks inside and is open to the bottom to drip over your sink.  This is even better because I can keep my over-the-sink window view but very efficiently use the space in small kitchen to dry items and then store it away.  Bonus:  you can things over the rails into the sink to dry.  Very easy to roll up and store away.  Wish it was made in more colors than gray.  I'd choose cream to or chrome to match my kitchen better.
So functional, clever and sturdy. Easy to roll and put away whenever not needed.

Cant tell you how much I enjoy this kitchen device.  Love Love Love it.  I have a big sink, but was only using half of it because I had a dry rack in half.  Now I dry on top and roll away when not in use.  My big sink is back!
This is a convenience item.

It significantly reduced all the dish clutter because you can't store as much onto this rack.
So, if your objective is to find an alternate storage space for your dishes, this will not help.
However, if you like your sink clean and tidy, you will appreciate this item.
Everyone loves this and immediately wants to know where I got it.  Bet you've sold a bunch to my friends, family and neighbors.
Much more durable than I thought it would be and a good size.

I didn't know how bad I needed this product until I had it. This is being used every day and it's such a lifesaver for my small kitchen. I use it on the table underneath hot items to protect my table. I also use it as a drying rack for my dishes and it's takes up almost no space. It's a great alternative to those ugly dish strainer is that most people have in their homes I would highly recommend it don't think about it just buy it.
Fantastic item.
This is just the right size for our large sink.  I was looking for an option to the standard dish drainer and this works great.
It's definitely a good buy. I'm very happy with my purchase.
No more wet drying cloth on my counter.  This is great, doesn't rust and when I am done with dishes, I just roll it up and put it away.  I can even stand cookie sheets up vertically to dry.

I like my counter tops clear, and tried collapsible dish drying racks, which were never worth the trouble, so lived with the standard ones for too long.  This rack is great:  it does what I need for draining dishes after washing, and even works for drying vegies after washing.  It has a low visual imprint, and rolls up when I want it to.  Better than I ever expected.
So convenient for a tiny apartment
Great for washing fruits and veggies too.
I really like this.  It rolls up and you can easily put it away when not is use but works great as a dish drain above a wide sink.
This small tool has made dish washing so much more efficient while still creating more work space in and near the sink.We are very happy with our LifeQVC Over the Sink Drying Rack..
Great product.  It sits perfectly on top of my sink and it is easy to clean and gives me quick access to my dishes
I wasn't sure how much I would use this but this has become one of the things in my kitchen I can't live without.  It saves my some precious counterspace
Amazing product. Highly recommended.

Wonderful solution to those drying baskets that just sit inside your sink!
I remodeled my kitchen a few years back and had a new sink installed. However, the shape and dimensions of the kitchen sink have made it difficult to find a drying basket that fit properly. Then I came across this rack by accident on Amazon. Ordered it and LOVE it! It leaves space under the rack for thawing foods like meats, ect, and when I'm finished drying my dishes, I simply roll it up and store it between the faucet and wall. It's sturdy enough to hold my cast iron skillet, which is a plus (that skillet is pretty heavy), and it doubles as a pot holder if needed. I've taken casserole dishes straight out of the oven and set them on the rack when space was limited. (It's rated for up to 400 degrees). I'll be purchasing a few more as Christmas gifts this year.
It is really handy. I use it for washing vegetables, dishes.
My wife like easy
Fits perfect over the very deep sink.  Items dry fast because it's open all around and raised. If you need that part of the sink, you just roll part of it.  Love it.

Perfect size for what i needed.  Sits over the smaller sink.  Good quality product, and I love that it can be thrown into the dishwasher now and then without having the coating melt off like my last rack did.  Well worth what I paid for this.
So convenient and sturdy.
